articleTitle: Breakthroughs of using Photodynamic Therapy and Gold Nanoparticles in Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The term “cancer” covers more than a hundred diseases that assign one trait: the abandoned growth of abnormal cells that abolish healthy tissues and have the potential to spread outside its site of origin. When a malignant tumor originates in the breast, it is called breast cancer. Gold nano particles display potential for both the imaging and cure of breast cancer. From a logistical standpoint, most breast tumors arise near the skin's surface, where they may possibly be extracted and handled despite the NIR laser's minimal tissue penetration. Photodynamic therapy is a fairly new treatment option for both cancer and non-cancer diseases that involves the activation of certain dyes with light in the existence of molecular oxygen (photosensitizers) that the target tissue has absorbed in a very selective manner. The combination of hyperthermia and photoelectric dose improvement of radiation therapy could be effectively treat superficial positioned inflammatory breast cancer sorrecurrence in the post-mastectomy chest wall. In this review paper, the novel work in photothermal therapy is debated, as well as the combined effects of gold nanoparticles and photothermal heating on breast cancer cells are studied in details.

articleTitle: Performance and Stability analysis of Dye-Sensitized Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Recently, considerable advancement has been made in the progress of fundamental and applied facets of solar cells, especially in light weight materials and inexpensive electrode materials for the development of energy conversion devices. Among these devices, the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> generation type of solar cells i.e., Dye-Sensitized Solar Cells (DSSCs) gained a remarkable attention owing to their distinctive features like ease of fabrication, fascinating appearance, etc. Herein, we predominantly concentrate on the performance and stability of the proposed DSSC at indoor and outdoor light intensities.

articleTitle: Simulation of thin-film transistor based winner-take-all circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: This paper discusses simulation of thin film transistors (TFT) in COMSOL. SPICE parameters are extracted from COMSOL simulation and have been used for modelling a winner-take-all circuit. The polysilicon-based WTA circuit showed a delay of ~3.7 μs between input and output with sharp rise and fall times. This work is the first analysis of a thin film winner-take-all (WTA) circuit which can enable low-cost brightness tracking circuits.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Nanoscaled GaN-BTG MOSFET for Analog/Linearity and Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: This paper presents the comparative study of a proposed device GaN-BTG MOSFET with BTG-MOSFET and CTG-MOSFET in terms of electrical characteristics, analog and linearity parameters by performing simulation using TCAD. The GaN-BTG MOSFET is obtained by modifying a conventional trenched gate structure where GaN is used as the replacement of silicon substrate, having a stacking of silicon dioxide (SiO2) and hafnium dioxide (HfO2) at the gate terminal. The comparative study shows that the GaN-BTG MOSFET is better in terms of transfer and output characteristics and transconductance whereas analog and low-power high-linearity parameters need improvement.

articleTitle: A Facile Method for Synthesizing Graphene Polyaniline Composite for Supercapacitor Electrode Fabrication and Its Enhanced Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The research community in the area of energy storage technology is more focused on supercapacitors (SC) because of its notable features like storing a high amount of energy, excellent cyclability, quick charging feature, and high current delivering capability in a smaller footprint. Graphene and polyaniline (PANI) are the two primary candidates under supercapacitor materials research coming below carbon and polymer groups. Graphene has exceptionally good electrical and mechanical properties, and polyaniline is one of the best-conducting semi-flexible polymers. The normal route for making graphene polyaniline composite is time consuming, and hence we conducted a facile method for fabricating the graphene PANI composites for the preparation of supercapacitor electrodes. The SEM, TEM, FTIR, Raman, and XRD results showed good intercalation between graphene and PANI. Also, the SEM images showed the graphene surface is coated with PANI nanofibers. The CV results exhibited excellent electrochemical performance and capacitance retention ratio. The specific capacitance observed from cyclic voltammetry was 235.4, 179.2, 120.4, 84.8, and 55.0 F/g at various scan rates of 10, 20, 50, 100, and 200 mV/s respectively. Moreover, the capacitance retention ratio was more than 90% after 1000 cycles.

articleTitle: Android Application Development Based Tourist Guiding Mobile Application Using Java & XML Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: The proposed model in this paper is a Tourist Guiding Mobile Application which is based on the Android Application Development Technology. The application is designed in an offline mode. It uses the advance coding of Java and JavaScript. The idea behind making this project is to provide a single interacting platform where tourists can access all the information related to their tourist spot by just a single click. It is designed in an offline mode so that if by chance there is network connectivity problem, then users will be able to access all the information without the use of Internet connectivity. In this Tourist Guiding Mobile Application, we have tried to build up speaking bot without the use of any Machine Language, which can directly work on the inputs provided by the users and yields the required outputs. At the backend coding, we have interfaced java instruction with the xml coding so that we can implement chatting bots and speaking bots together in just a single application. The application is cost effective, as there is no need of making any kind of payments to access any information on the application. The application contains the set of authorized data about the description of the tourist spot, First Aid Remedies that one often needs during travelling, all the nearest Railways and Airports, Traditional Food and the nearest Hospitals for the emergency cases. The application is all set to work on Google Play App Store.

articleTitle: Sub-5nm E/D GaN Nanowire FET for Low Power High Speed Logic Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: In this work, design and simulation-based performance analysis of GaN NW FET for Depletion and Enhancement Mode of operation and its suitability for the low power digital switches has been carried out. The paper reports a novel way for obtaining both Enhancement-Mode as well as Depletion-Mode devices on the same chips based on the variation in the Nanowire channel thickness (Tnw) thereby increasing the functionality of the circuits. The device offers an Ion/Ioff ratio of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> in the E-Mode and ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> in the D-Mode. The high values of Ion/Ioff in the E-Mode reveal controlled SCEs making them suitable for digital logic with high speed and low power dissipations. The paper also focusses on the various tradeoff that should be made for efficient performance in extremely scaled devices.

articleTitle: Detection and Prevention of Hypervisor and VM Attacks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Virtualization is a rapidly evolving technology in big data, mobile cloud computing and grid computing due to its nature of less cost, flexibility, efficiency and resources utilization with proper management and efficiency in consuming power in recent years. Therefore, many platforms have evolved in the scenario such as VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V server and Xen Hypervisors etcVMware ESXi is one of the high level ways of providing internal cloud security infrastructures. As the ESXi have the peculiarity of providing community interest but anyhow it somewhat lacks security concerns. In this Paper we implemented two major attacks former attack is known as hypervisor and later one is VM attack. Kali Linux is one of the striking tool which helps with its advance features in detecting and uncovering various vulnerabilities, from the machine.. For this purpose, Kali Linux setup and installation will be explored in details. Moreover, a method to prevent vulnerable server is also presented. In Future we are looking forward to explore simulated attacks on the server by exploiting benefits from firewalls

articleTitle: High Refractive Index Dielectric TiO2 and Graphene Oxide as Salient Spacers for > 300-fold Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: Plasmon-coupled luminescence emission technology has evolved into a resourceful biophotonic methodology for obtaining enhanced sensitivity and selectivity of sensor platform. Reliable and efficient devices have been demonstrated on account of sharply directional and highly p-polarized emission characteristics of SPCE, with excellent background suppression capabilities. Although diverse metal nanoparticles (NPs) have been examined as active spacer nanolayer material in SPCE, the utility of high refractive index (HRI) dielectric nanomaterials are seldom discussed. In this work, we demonstrate the salient features of HRI TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> NPs to realize tunable and augmented emission enhancements. Further, the first-time synergy of versatile graphene oxide and TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> spacer nanolayer has resulted in >300-fold fluorescence emission enhancements from radiating dipoles. Mobile phone based detection methodology has presented reliable and reproducible results to be amenable for resource limited settings.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic High Dimensional Computing Architecture for Classification Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: High Dimensional Computing (HDC) includes the creation of High Dimensional Vectors, their storage in memory, and their functioning for different mathematical operations. The operations on HD vectors involve binding, bundling, and permutation, making it suitable to generate various kinds of architectures for performing different HDC applications. In this work, the High Dimensional Computing application involves language identification and classification of medical images using our proposed 2-D architectures. For the representation of the entities for the classification applications, 10000-bit random vectors are used. The high-dimensional entities are generated by using different random number generators and image processing techniques depending on the type of application. The experimental results, details about the data set used, architecture design information, benefits, and memory issues of HDC are also presented in this work. This new computational method carried out using high dimensional vectors introduces a new model for machine learning and can be used in different applications such as diagnosing Covid 19, brain tumour, classification of benign and malignant cancer cells, gesture classification and bio signal processing.

publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience & Nanotechnology (5NANO)
abstract: It is my great pleasure to welcome you to the IEEE International Conference on Nanoelectronics, Nanophotonics, Nanomaterials, Nanobioscience and Nanotechnology (IEEE 5NANO2021) - a platform for researchers on 29th & 30th April, 2021. Engineering, unlike science, is concerned not only with knowledge of natural phenomena, but also with how knowledge can serve humankind's needs and wants. Such variables as cost, user compatibility, producibility, safety, and adaptability to various external operating conditions and environments must be taken into account in the design, development, operational support, and maintenance of the products and services that engineers create. Thus, engineering involves the integration of knowledge, techniques, methods, and experiences from many fields. The highlight of this multi - conference is, it associated with high quality journals like IEEE Xplore, Elsevier, Taylor & Francis, Springer, etc which ensures the quality of the conference. The conference received 246 technical papers and after detailed review, 92 papers were selected for oral presentation. The conference is so scheduled to have around 6 parallel sessions in six different tracks. These proceedings have been edited by able scholars which makes them officially valuable like any professional journal. I wish all the participants an enriching conference. The excellent efforts engaged by the international scientific committee and the local organizing to organize this conference are laudable.
